general_steps: Keep your policy number and the documents for your product ready.
Intimate the insurer as soon as possible (many policies require intimation within 24 to 48 hours of the event or admission).
Submit the claim form and documents on the portal, by email or through your insurer's helpline.
Note your claim number and respond promptly to any queries or document requests.
Track the status; approved claims are settled to you or directly to the hospital/garage.

Health: Copy of the policy schedule / policy number
Original hospital bills and payment receipts
Life: Copy of the policy schedule / policy number
Police FIR / post-mortem report (for accidental death)
Motor: Copy of the policy schedule / policy number
Home: Copy of the policy schedule / policy number
Photos or video of the damage
List of damaged items with values
FIR or fire brigade report where applicable
Travel: Copy of the policy schedule / policy number
Proof of expenses or airline delay certificate
Medical reports and bills (for medical claims)
